title: Quote
purpose: Review documents and version history, then edit, issue, revise or withdraw when eligible.
summary: One quote: its document, every version and its history. From here you edit, issue, revise or withdraw it when its state allows.

tasks.title: Issue the draft to the client
steps: Check the document, then select [[Edit]] if a line, the valid-until date or the terms need changing.
Select [[Issue version]]. It needs at least one line and a valid-until date of today or later.
Issuing freezes the lines, prices, total, scope and terms of that version.

tasks.title: Change a quote the client already has
steps: Select [[Revise]]. The lines, prices and terms are copied into a new draft and the editor opens.
Set a new valid-until date and issue the new version. The client keeps seeing the last issued version until then.

tasks.title: Withdraw a quote
steps: The quote leaves the client's quote pages. Its versions are kept.

tasks.title: Look at an earlier version
steps: Under Versions, select the version number. The document shows that version as it was issued.

good_to_know: Accepted quotes cannot be revised or withdrawn.
While a quote is Being revised, the client can read the last issued version but cannot accept or decline it.
Expired means the valid-until date has passed. Revise an expired quote to offer it again.
Standard turnaround is what you state to the client. It does not set an order's delivery target or a holding time.
Print opens browser printing only. It does not issue the quote or store a report.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Project managers and admins can use price lists and quotes. Other staff roles do not grant this access. Admin includes the project manager role. A superuser flag alone supplies no application role.

sections.title: State and selection
paragraphs: Header state, title and client/project are current live values. The document shows the selected version. Latest is selected initially; Versions links open older versions. An unknown version request falls back to latest. Older versions show Superseded and Show the current version. Version tables are not paginated.

Accepted/Declined banners show decision version, actor and time. Acceptance includes any client reference; decline includes its reason. Expired means the valid-until date passed. A decision banner describes the current quote decision even while an older document is selected.

items.label: Quote number · version
items.description: Identifies the quote and selected version. Its title describes the work. Drafts use current names; issued versions retain the title, client and project names recorded at issue.

items.label: Prepared for
items.description: Client and optional project covered by this version. An absent optional project is not filled from a later draft.

items.label: Issued
items.description: Issue date for this version, or Not issued for a staff draft.

items.label: Valid until
items.description: Last calendar date an issued version is open for a client decision, using the laboratory date. Expired appears after that date while the quote is Issued.

items.label: Standard turnaround
items.description: Stated business days from receipt, or Not stated. This does not itself set an order delivery target or an analytical holding time.

items.label: Description
items.description: Stored text for the test, fee or discount. A test’s default identifies analyte, method/version, matrix and analytical unit.

items.label: Type
items.description: Test, Fee or Discount / adjustment describes the charge.

items.label: Qty
items.description: Positive whole-number multiplier, such as the number of samples quoted.

items.label: Unit price
items.description: Exact USD amount per line unit. Discounts/adjustments are zero or negative; test and fee prices are non-negative.

items.label: Amount
items.description: Computed quantity multiplied by stored unit price, in USD.

items.label: Total (USD)
items.description: Exact sum of amounts including discounts; cannot be negative.

items.label: Scope and assumptions / Terms
items.description: Client-visible text for this version. Shown only when supplied and frozen when issued.

items.label: Version
items.description: Open that version; authorized staff can see unissued drafts and issued versions.

items.label: Issued
items.description: Issue date/time, or Draft.

items.label: Total (USD)
items.description: Stored total for this version.

items.label: Print
items.description: Open browser printing. Does not issue a quote or create a stored report.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Shown to project managers/admins on the latest unissued Draft or Being revised version; opens the draft editor.

items.label: Issue version
items.description: Publish the latest draft to the client and freeze presentation, lines, prices, total, scope and terms. Requires a stored line, valid-until date today or later, and a current version/revision. Sets Issued and clears previous decision fields. A repeated completed issue does not issue twice.

items.label: Revise
items.description: Shown to project managers/admins on the latest Issued or Declined version, including expired quotes. Copies lines, prices, list, turnaround, scope and terms into the next draft; leaves validity unset and opens editing. Client can still inspect the last issued version but cannot decide while Being revised. Accepted or Withdrawn quotes cannot be revised.

items.label: Withdraw quote
items.description: Shown to project managers/admins for the latest version unless Accepted or already Withdrawn. Required Reason explains the withdrawal. Submitting records withdrawal and reason without deleting versions; the quote disappears from client quote pages. Stale changes are refused. Accepted quotes cannot be withdrawn.

items.label: Quotes
items.description: Return to the staff list.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required reason for withdrawing this quote; recorded in history.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size / Close form / Cancel
items.description: With enhanced controls, reason actions open in a dialog. Change its size without saving, or close/cancel without submitting. If prompted, Keep editing resumes and Discard changes leaves without saving. Wait for an in-progress action to complete.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: Shows recorded events in oldest-first order. Each event identifies action, time, actor and any reason. Changes and their audit event save together. The timeline does not display every stored before-and-after value.
